prod: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette 75ml Gift Set with 70g Deodorant Stick

Supplier lists this in the Bath and Body tab; built as a fragrance gift set like earlier sets. EAN 3616304197420 matched on Jomashop (title) and Bonherre (EDT 75ml + Deostick 70g). Superdrug's 75ml + 75ml stick duo has another EAN (3616307511537), probably another year's set. Pyramid agreed by Parfumo and Bonherre (The Perfume Shop gives a shorter list with lavender in the heart). 1988 per Parfumo and The Perfume Shop. Men. Awaiting photos.

Abercrombie & Fitch Away Weekend Man Eau de Toilette 100ml

EAN 0085715169402 matched on Galaxus.ch and Triple Traders (EDT 100ml, men). Pyramid agreed by Triple Traders, Parfumdreams and Scentadvice. 2023 per Triple Traders and Scentadvice. Also stocked by Superdrug UK. Men. Awaiting photos.
Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Blue for Her Eau de Parfum 50ml

Barcode 85715167217 used in Carrefour UAE's 50ml EDP product URL (not labelled EAN); Superdrug 100ml has sibling EAN 0085715167224. Pyramid identical on Lookfantastic, Carrefour UAE and Fragrancecart (Superdrug's 100ml page gives a different list, ignored). Release year not confirmed. Women. Awaiting photos.
Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Sheer Eau de Parfum 50ml

EAN 0085715167620 matched on Galaxus.ch and Triple Traders (EDP 50ml). Pyramid agreed by Triple Traders and Lookfantastic (Superdrug adds pear, raspberry, peony, jasmine, freesia – not confirmed, left out). Not the original First Instinct for Her. Release year not confirmed. Women. Awaiting photos.
Abercrombie & Fitch Naturally Fierce Eau de Parfum 30ml

EAN 0085715167828 matched on aio.lv (EDP 30ml, women). Pyramid agreed by Lookfantastic, Superdrug and Escentual (moss not on Escentual). Floral woody musk per Escentual, Superdrug, Walmart. Release year not confirmed (Parfumo page unreliable). Not A&F Fierce (men's). Women. Awaiting photos.
Abercrombie & Fitch Naturally Fierce Eau de Parfum 50ml

Barcode 085715167804 shown on Walmart's 1.7oz (50ml) EDP page; no UK EAN page found. Pyramid agreed by Lookfantastic, Superdrug and Escentual (moss not on Escentual). Floral woody musk per Escentual, Superdrug, Walmart. Release year not confirmed (Parfumo page unreliable). Not A&F Fierce (men's). Women. Awaiting photos.
Antonio Banderas The Icon Splendid Eau de Parfum 100ml

EAN 8411061084922 not found online. 100ml EDP for women confirmed by Woolworths SA and FragranceNet; pyramid identical on both (Fuschia gift set agrees). 2024 per FragranceNet. Perfume.com calls it a men's fragrance with different notes (ignored); supplier's Women kept. Awaiting photos.
Antonio Banderas The Secret Eau de Toilette 100ml

Supplier barcode 8411061080641 not found online, but the supplier stockfile lists it together with 8411061701034 on the same line; 8411061701034 is matched to The Secret EDT 100ml on aio.lv and Galaxus. Not Golden Secret / Secret Temptation. Pyramid agreed by Ferwer and Schiphol shop (aio.lv agrees). 2010 per Ferwer. Men. Awaiting photos.

EAN 0812256024194 matched on Superdrug (Body Mist 236ml, women; no longer online) and OnBuy. Notes agreed by Parfumo and Food4Less (Argos lists Ari's notes – ignored). Body mist, not hair mist. Women. Awaiting photos.
